en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with a broad weir or small dam in the foreground. On the left bank stands a large, ornate multi‑storey building with steep roofs and dormer windows, reflected in the calm water. Dense trees line the riverbank, and further in the background a church spire rises above lower buildings. In the upper left corner there is printed German text identifying the location as Grimma in Saxony and mentioning a royal administrative district.
